# CookUnity

> > Chef-crafted meal delivery service connecting customers with award-winning chefs across 40+ cuisines and multiple cities.

CookUnity is a personalized meal subscription platform featuring 300+ chef-prepared meals from 150+ award-winning chefs including James Beard Award winners and Food Network personalities. The service operates across major US cities including New York, Los Angeles, Austin, Chicago, Seattle, and Miami.

## Key Topics

- Chef-crafted meal delivery
- Meal subscription service
- Plant-based meals
- Local kitchens
- Restaurant chefs
- Prepared meals
- Ready-to-eat meals
- Meal customization
- Latin American cuisine
- James Beard Award
- Food Network
- Farm-to-table
- Culinary diversity
- Chef partnerships
- Meal plans
